content: दीन {%a.%} [दी-क्त तस्य न] .²1 Poor, indigent. .²2 Distressed, ruined, afflicted, miserable, wretched. .²3 Sorry, dejected, melancholy, sad; सा विरहे तव दीना <ls>Gīt. 4</ls>. .²4 Timid, frightened. .²5 Mean, piteous; यं यं पश्यसि तस्य तस्य पुरतो मा ब्रूहि दीनं वचः <ls>Bh. 2. 51</ls>. .{@-नः@} A poor person, one in distress or misery; दीनानां कल्पवृक्षः <ls>Mk. 1. 48</ls>; दिनानि दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य <ls>R. 2. 25</ls>. .{@-नम्@} Distress, wretchedness. .{@-ना@} The female of a mouse or shrew.
